comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 7dc3dab and doc/manual.md in the same tree. The module declares no parameters, inputs or outputs at all; the save button is a PinwheelRust widget added with addChild rather than addParam, so Rack's parameter list is empty and nothing on this panel can be clicked for help. All three menu items start unchecked, so a file written straight away carries brands, plugin names and module names in their own case and no web addresses.
